action.content:
Based on the general rule for adjective order in English sentences, which is:

1. Opinion adjectives (e.g. good, bad, beautiful, ugly)
2. Size adjectives (e.g. big, small, long, short)
3. Age adjectives (e.g. old, new, young)
4. Shape adjectives (e.g. round, square, rectangular)
5. Color adjectives (e.g. red, blue, green)
6. National origin adjectives (e.g. American, British, Chinese)
7. Material adjectives (e.g. wooden, metal, plastic)

I will apply this rule to each option:

Q: Which sentence has the correct adjective order:
Options:
(A) rubber terrible ship
(B) terrible rubber ship
A: (B)

In this case, the adjective "terrible" is an opinion adjective, and "rubber" is a material adjective. According to the rule, opinion adjectives come before material adjectives, so the correct order is (B) terrible rubber ship.

Q: Which sentence has the correct adjective order:
Options:
(A) repulsive small Brazilian exercise ship
(B) Brazilian repulsive exercise small ship
A: (A)

In this case, the adjective "Brazilian" is a national origin adjective, "repulsive" is an opinion adjective, "exercise" is a shape adjective, and "small" is a size adjective. According to the rule, national origin adjectives come before opinion adjectives, and size adjectives come before shape adjectives, so the correct order is (A) repulsive small Brazilian exercise ship.

Q: Which sentence has the correct adjective order:
Options:
(A) blue gold wonderful square shoe
(B) wonderful square blue gold shoe
A: (B)

In this case, the adjective "wonderful" is an opinion adjective, "square" is a shape adjective, "blue" is a color adjective, and "gold" is a material adjective. According to the rule, opinion adjectives come before shape adjectives, and color adjectives come before material adjectives, so the correct order is (B) wonderful square blue gold shoe.

Options:
(A) green new chair
(B) new green chair
A: 

In this case, the adjective "new" is an age adjective, and "green" is a color adjective. According to the rule, age adjectives come before color adjectives, so the correct order is (A) green new chair.
